title: -ig: How Long Are You Going For?

sections.title: Saying how long a trip lasts
sections.content: You already know -ig from -tól/-től ... -ig ("from ... to ..."). On its own, -ig also gives the length of a stay: két hétig means "for two weeks" and egy hónapig means "for a month." Ask meddig? ("until when / for how long?") to get this kind of answer, alongside the mennyi ideig? ("for how much time?") you may hear used the same way.

items.english: How long are you staying abroad?
We're staying for two weeks, then we're traveling home.

sections.content: -ig never changes with vowel harmony — it's always -ig, on any word: hétig, hónapig, Budapestig.
